title: A Seek Step Updates the Head Position
statement: Let $M$ be a $k$-tape machine with the four seek phases, let $i$ be a work-tape index, and let $d$ be a configuration. For phases $q,q'$, integer $z$, and movement $m\in\{-1,0,1\}$, suppose the transition from the configuration obtained from $d$ by setting the phase to $q$ and shifting head $i$ by $z$ is the action that leaves the input head and all tape contents unchanged, moves work-tape head $i$ by $m$ (and every other work-tape head by zero), emits nothing, and enters phase $q'$. Then one machine step gives the configuration obtained from $d$ by setting the phase to $q'$ and shifting head $i$ by $z+m$.
hypotheses_covered: Transition at the specified configuration equals the stated tape action
